instruction.name: pcaddu18i
instruction.description: Compute PC plus a sign-extended 20-bit immediate shifted left by 18.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: pcaddu18i $r12, 1; pcaddu18i $r13, 1; pcaddu18i $r14, 1; pcaddu18i $r15, 1; pcaddu18i $r16, 1; pcaddu18i $r17, 1; pcaddu18i $r18, 1; pcaddu18i $r19, 1
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --asm 'pcaddu18i $r12, 1; pcaddu18i $r13, 1; pcaddu18i $r14, 1; pcaddu18i $r15, 1; pcaddu18i $r16, 1; pcaddu18i $r17, 1; pcaddu18i $r18, 1; pcaddu18i $r19, 1'
throughput.notes: PC-relative address generation. Measured with 8, 17 and 30 independent destinations at --unroll 50/200: 3.24, 7.08 and 12.42 cycles, that is 0.405-0.417 CPI (2.4 instructions per cycle), independent of the lane count and of whether the destinations repeat. A mixed body of 15 `pcaddi` and 15 `add.d` takes 9.97 cycles, which is 15*5/12 + 15*0.25, so the two share the same issue slots and the PC adder costs five slots per twelve instructions rather than the four of a plain ALU operation. It is therefore neither 2 IPC nor 4 IPC: the ceiling is 2.4.

notes: No GPR source; latency is not defined. Throughput only.
